settings.rag_clear_all_intro: Choose what to clear. This cannot be undone.
settings.rag_clear_kind_diary_hint: Deletes retrieval vectors only. Diary text stays.
settings.rag_clear_kind_partner_hint: Deletes partner memory text and its vectors. Other devices will lose it after sync.
settings.rag_clear_kind_manual_hint: Deletes memories you added by hand, and their vectors. Other devices will lose them after sync.
settings.rag_clear_kind_node_hint: Deletes node retrieval vectors only. People and links on the graph stay.
settings.rag_clear_kind_graph_hint: Deletes this workspace’s life graph nodes and links. Other devices will be empty after sync.
settings.rag_clear_all_confirm: Please type "CONFIRM CLEAR" below to clear all RAG memory:
settings.rag_clear_all_mismatch: Input does not match, operation cancelled.
settings.rag_disabled_alert: Companion memory feature has been turned off~
settings.rag_startup_embed_reminder_hint: If anything is still unembedded after launch, you will be prompted to fill it in. Turn this off to stop the automatic prompt.
settings.rag_migration_already_running: A migration task is already running.
settings.rag_migration_api_key_missing: The embedding provider has no API key. Add and save an API key under AI Providers, then retry migration.
settings.rag_migration_dimension_failed: Failed to detect the new model dimension. Migration aborted.
settings.rag_migration_verify_partial: Migration finished with warnings ⚠️ Some chunks were not migrated ({{completed}}/{{total}}).
settings.rag_migration_verify_stale: Migration finished with warnings ⚠️ Stale model data remains ({{completed}}/{{total}}).
settings.rag_migration_verify_both: Migration finished with warnings ⚠️ Some chunks were not migrated and stale data remains ({{completed}}/{{total}}).
settings.rag_migration_aborting: Migration failed. Restoring previous embeddings and model settings...
settings.rag_migration_aborted_consecutive: Migration stopped after {{limit}} consecutive failures. Previous data and embedding model have been restored.
settings.rag_migration_cancelled: Migration cancelled. Previous data and embedding model have been restored.
settings.rag_migration_backup_lost: Migration backup table is missing. Start a new embedding migration; if a rollback snapshot exists, try Restore migration backup in settings.
settings.rag_migration_cancel_confirm: Cancel migration and restore the previous vector data and embedding model?
settings.rag_migration_aborted_restored: Migration aborted. Previous vector data and embedding model settings have been restored.
settings.rag_migration_interrupted_restore_desc: Migration did not finish. A full pre-migration backup is available — you can restore your previous vectors and embedding model in one click.
settings.rag_migration_interrupted_resume_desc: Migration did not finish. You can continue from the last progress or restore the backup first.
settings.rag_migration_restore_confirm: Restore pre-migration vector data and embedding model? Current incomplete progress will be discarded.
settings.rag_migration_restore_success: Pre-migration vector data and embedding model have been restored.
settings.rag_migration_complete: Vector migration finished. Diary memories have been re-embedded with the new model.
settings.rag_migration_interrupted_toast: Vector migration did not finish. A backup was kept—you can resume or restore it from Memory → Vector fragments.
settings.rag_model_mismatch_desc: The local vector database was built using a different embedding model. You must perform a migration, or search features will fail.
settings.rag_batch_embed_confirm: This will embed pending diaries, memories, graph nodes, and knowledge sources. It only writes local vectors and does not create sync traffic. Start now?
settings.rag_migration_running_toast: Knowledge base migration is in progress, please try again later.
settings.rag_indexing_in_progress: Memory organizing is in progress, please try again later.
settings.rag_diary_embed_api_unavailable: The embedding API is unavailable. No diary vectors were written. Check the embedding model endpoint.
settings.rag_diary_embed_no_vectors: The embedding API is unavailable; no diary vectors were written
settings.rag_embed_adapter_unavailable: The embedding model is not ready, so memories, graph nodes, and knowledge cannot be filled in
settings.rag_batch_embed_partial: Indexing finished, but {{count}} graph nodes could not be embedded.
settings.rag_batch_embed_cancel_confirm: Cancel will stop embeddings that have not started. Already written vectors will be kept. Cancel now?
settings.rag_batch_embed_cancelled: Indexing cancelled. Completed embeddings were kept.
settings.rag_diary_auto_embed_failed: Diary saved, but memory embedding failed. Open Memory and tap "Start organizing memory" to re-embed.
settings.rag_diary_auto_embed_failed_with_reason: Diary saved, but memory embedding failed: {{message}}. Open Memory and tap "Start organizing memory" to re-embed.
settings.rag_diary_embed_pending_detail: A recently saved or edited diary could not be written to memory vectors (network may have dropped). Your diary text is safe—tap below to finish embedding.
settings.rag_batch_embed_concurrency_hint: How many diaries to embed in parallel. Higher is faster but more likely to hit API rate limits; default is 20—lower if you hit rate limits.
settings.rag_empty_desc: Searchable memories appear here after you write a diary, add a manual fragment, or finish embedding partner and node memories.
settings.rag_empty_search: Try another keyword, or switch between semantic and text search.
settings.rag_empty_kind: No memories of this type yet
settings.rag_empty_kind_desc: Memories of this source appear here after embedding finishes.
settings.rag_clear_node_embed_confirm: This only clears the vector on this node. The entity in the graph stays. Continue?
settings.rag_edit_diary_blocked: Diary memory fragments are generated from the diary text. Edit the diary itself, then re-run the pending embedding in the memory center.
settings.rag_semantic_unavailable_message: Enable RAG memory and configure an embedding model to use semantic search. Go to settings?
settings.rag_backup_actions: Enter number to restore, or "delete:number" to delete:
settings.rag_confirm_restore: Restore will clear current memories and import from backup. Continue?
settings.rag_top_k_tooltip: Maximum number of most similar memories returned when AI searches. Higher values recall more, but may include less relevant fragments.
settings.rag_similarity_threshold_tooltip: Only memory fragments with similarity above this value are kept. A higher threshold means stricter matching and fewer results.
